To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the contribution of muscle cocontraction and muscle eccentric activity to joint stiffness varies as a function of task demands.
muscular cocontraction contributes to joint stiffness regulation in some but not all tasks.
muscular cocontraction is an effective means to regulate joint stiffness in the presence of low demands but is not the sole means to regulate joint compliance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of joint stiffness in a task that required the participants to adjust stiffness in a manner that was appropriate for the task demands.
the regulation of joint stiffness in a variety of tasks and the mechanisms by which stiffness is regulated.
the role that cocontraction plays in the regulation of joint stiffness.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present study has identified muscular cocontractions and eccentric activities as two mechanisms that contribute to the regulation of joint stiffness.
muscular cocontraction is a mechanism for stiffness regulation, but it is not the sole one, and it is used in some circumstances but not others.
the mechanisms of stiffness regulation are highly task dependent.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
cocontraction and/or eccentric activity are the mechanisms that different individuals use for stiffness regulation.
stiffness regulation is a complex task that requires a combination of strategies.

stiffness regulation can be achieved through the use of cocontraction and/or eccentric activity and that the mechanisms used by an individual to regulate joint stiffness vary as a function of task demands.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mechanisms that different individuals used varied as a task demands changed.
cocontraction and other strategies for stiffness control are not mutually exclusive.
cocontraction and the activation of eccentric muscles are not the only ways to increase joint stiffness.
